title: GENIE: Watermarking Graph Neural Networks for Link Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2406.04805v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The rapid adoption, usefulness, and resource-intensive training of Graph Neural Network (GNN) models have made them an invaluable intellectual property in graph-based machine learning. However, their wide-spread adoption also makes them susceptible to stealing, necessitating robust Ownership Demonstration (OD) techniques. Watermarking is a promising OD framework for deep neural networks, but existing methods fail to generalize to GNNs due to the non-Euclidean nature of graph data. Existing works on GNN watermarking primarily focus on node and graph classification, overlooking Link Prediction (LP). In this paper, we propose GENIE (watermarking Graph nEural Networks for lInk prEdiction), the first scheme to watermark GNNs for LP. GENIE creates a novel backdoor for both node-representation and subgraph-based LP methods, utilizing a unique trigger set and a secret watermark vector. translated_title: GENIE：面向链接预测的图神经网络水印技术
translated_abstract: 图神经网络（GNN）模型的快速普及、实用价值以及训练所需的大量资源，使其成为基于图的机器学习中极为宝贵的知识产权。然而，其广泛应用也使它们容易被窃取，因此需要可靠的所有权证明（OD）技术。水印技术是一种有前景的深度神经网络所有权证明框架，但由于图数据的非欧几里得特性，现有方法难以泛化到图神经网络。现有的图神经网络水印研究主要集中在节点分类和图分类任务上，而忽略了链接预测（LP）。在本文中，我们提出了GENIE（面向链接预测的图神经网络水印方案），这是首个针对链接预测任务的图神经网络水印方案。GENIE为基于节点表示和基于子图的链接预测方法创建了一种新颖的后门，利用独特的触发集和秘密水印向量。我们的所有权证明方案配备了动态水印技术……
tldr: 本文提出了GENIE，这是首个针对链接预测任务的图神经网络水印方案，通过利用独特的触发集和秘密水印向量构建新颖的后门机制，实现对模型所有权的有效证明。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes GENIE, the first watermarking scheme for graph neural networks in link prediction, which creates a novel backdoor using a unique trigger set and a secret watermark vector to enable robust ownership demonstration.
